name: browser
title_zh: 后台开你自己的浏览器，登录态现成还能多开不抢焦点
tagline_zh: 最烦的是自动化一跑浏览器就跳到前台，你没法干别的，还得重新登录一遍。它直接接管你已登录的那个浏览器，在后台点、填。
tagline_en: Automation usually hijacks your screen and your logins. This drives your already-logged-in browser in the.
desc_en: Drive a real browser for any web task: read pages, click, fill forms, screenshot, log in, sign up. Default is "live" mode, the user's own running browser with their logins, driven in the BACKGROUND, so it never steals focus and many sessions run in parallel without fighting. Each session owns a group of tabs it can open, switch between and juggle. Also "headless" (invisible Chrome, fast bulk work)
why_zh: 默认「live」模式复用你正在跑的浏览器和登录态，不新开干净环境，所以不用重新过验证码和二次验证。
why_en: Live mode reuses your running browser and its sessions, so no fresh profile and no redoing captchas or 2FA.
limit_zh: 必须本机已有可被接管的浏览器；headless 模式是全新无登录态环境，需要登录的站点得自己先过验证码。
limit_en: Needs a local browser it can attach to; headless mode starts with no logins, so captcha/2FA sites stall and bulk runs can trip bot detection.
title_en: Drives your own logged-in browser in the background, many.
